---
title: "Who it is impacting"
---

Click on a stakeholder to learn more about their role and how AI in hiring affects them.

<div class="accordion" id="stakeholders">

<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#applicants">
Job Applicants
</button>
</h2>
<div id="applicants" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#stakeholders">
<div class="accordion-body">
<p>Job applicants are individuals who submit resumes when applying for jobs. Some applicants use AI tools to help write or improve their resumes, while others do not.</p>
<p><strong>Impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Applicants with access to AI tools may gain an advantage, while those without access may be rejected more often, even if equally qualified.</li>
<li>Increased competition may pressure all applicants to use AI tools, even if they prefer not to.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Interests</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Fair evaluation of qualifications</li>
<li>Equal opportunity in hiring</li>
<li>Transparency in hiring decisions</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Other Relevant Information</strong></p>
<p>Applicants may have different levels of access to technology and different levels of experience using AI tools.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#reviewers">
Resume Reviewers
</button>
</h2>
<div id="reviewers" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#stakeholders">
<div class="accordion-body">
<p>Resume reviewers are individuals responsible for reading and evaluating resumes during the hiring process.</p>
<p><strong>Impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>They may rely too heavily on AI tools, potentially overlooking strong candidates who do not match AI-generated patterns.</li>
<li>Their role may change or become reduced as automation increases.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Interests</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Efficient review of applications</li>
<li>Accurate identification of qualified candidates</li>
<li>Reduced workload</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Other Relevant Information</strong></p>
<p>Their decisions directly affect which candidates move forward in the hiring process.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#hr">
Human Resources (HR)
</button>
</h2>
<div id="hr" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#stakeholders">
<div class="accordion-body">
<p>HR professionals manage hiring processes and ensure that companies follow hiring policies and employment laws.</p>
<p><strong>Impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>They must balance efficiency with fairness while ensuring AI tools do not introduce discrimination.</li>
<li>They may face challenges in regulating and monitoring AI use.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Interests</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Fair and legal hiring practices</li>
<li>Efficient hiring processes</li>
<li>Reliable evaluation methods</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Other Relevant Information</strong></p>
<p>HR departments are responsible for balancing efficiency with ethical responsibility.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#aicompanies">
AI Companies
</button>
</h2>
<div id="aicompanies" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#stakeholders">
<div class="accordion-body">
<p>AI companies develop the tools used to generate and evaluate resumes.</p>
<p><strong>Impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>They benefit financially from increased AI use but are responsible for ensuring fairness and accuracy.</li>
<li>Poorly designed systems could contribute to bias in hiring.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Interests</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Innovation and product development</li>
<li>User trust</li>
<li>Responsible technology use</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Other Relevant Information</strong></p>
<p>The design of AI systems can influence hiring outcomes.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#environment">
The Environment
</button>
</h2>
<div id="environment" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#stakeholders">
<div class="accordion-body">
<p>The environment represents natural resources affected by the operation of AI technology and data centers.</p>
<p><strong>Impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Increased use of AI contributes to higher energy and water consumption, which may negatively impact the environment over time.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Interests</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Sustainable technology development</li>
<li>Reduced resource consumption</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Other Relevant Information</strong></p>
<p>Environmental impact is a long-term concern as AI use continues to grow.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>
